requirements: R1: Patch the internal task status synchronization logic to correctly identify and handle PRs that were closed on GitHub without being merged, preventing tasks from being falsely marked as done.

slices.title: Fix PR closure status synchronization
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR sync patch for this epic, I want to accurately detect unmerged closures, so that the internal task status is updated or reverted appropriately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task associated with a GitHub PR
When the PR is closed without being merged
Then the synchronization logic must not mark the task as done
And integration tests verify the unmerged closure scenario correctly
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive done tasks due to closed-unmerged PRs from current rate to 0%
